sentences.text: 1 "It is therefore most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble court may graciously be pleased to quash the impugned order dated 9.4.2014 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate III Shahjahanpur in complaint case no.412 of 2014, under section 498A I.P.C and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police station Ram Chandra Mission District Shahjahanpur.

It is further prayed that this Hon'ble court may kindly be pleased to stay the further proceeding in complaint case no. 412 of 2014 (Arsi vs. Rauf and another) under Section 498A I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act Police Station Ram Chandra Mission District Shahjahanpur pending before the court of judicial Magistrate III District Shahjahanpur.

sentences.text: It is further prayed that this Hon' the court may kindly be pleased to direct the present matter be placed before mediation Centre for settlement between the parties during the pendency of the present case before this Hon'ble court.
And/or pass any further order or direction which this Hon'ble court may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the case.

Otherwise the applicant shall suffer an irreparable loss and injury."
5.
The matter is of the year 2014.
There are chances of the matter being rendered infructuous by efflux of time.
6. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed as infructuous.
7. Interim order, if any, stands vacated.

8. Office to communicate this order to the trial court concerned within two weeks.
9.
If cause survives, the applicants will have liberty to file an appropriate application for reviving the matter.
